intro: A B2 text to read in one go. Follow the connectors, and notice what triggers each subjunctive.
p.festival.consejo: It is masculine: «el festival». In Spain there are thousands each year, mostly in summer.
p.ingresos.consejo: Almost always plural. The opposite is «los gastos», money going out.
p.vecino.consejo: It can be someone in your building or in your city: «los vecinos de la ciudad».
p.alojamiento.consejo: It comes from «alojar». The j sounds like a strong h: «a-lo-ha-MYEN-to».
p.casco antiguo.consejo: You say «el casco antiguo» or «el casco histórico». «Casco» here is the central area.
p.masificado.consejo: It comes from «masa». You say «un lugar masificado». It is an adjective: «masificada» if feminine.
p.comercio.consejo: «El comercio local» means the neighbourhood shops. The c sounds th: «ko-MER-thyo».
p.limitar.consejo: It comes from «límite». You say «limitar el número de» something. It is regular.
p.fianza.consejo: It is paid as a guarantee and is sometimes returned. The z sounds th: «FYAN-tha».
p.reto.consejo: It is a synonym of «desafío». The initial r sounds strong: «RRE-to».
p.equilibrio.consejo: You say «encontrar un equilibrio» and «perder el equilibrio». It has a diphthong: «e-ki-LI-bryo».
p.quejarse de.consejo: It takes «de»: «quejarse de algo» and «quejarse de que» + subjunctive.
p.convivir.consejo: It is «con» + «vivir». You live together with other people in the same place.
p.puesto de trabajo.consejo: It is a formal way of saying «empleo». You say «crear puestos de trabajo».
b1.titulo: How to read a B2 text
b1.texto:
Before you look up a word, find the **connectors**. They are the skeleton of the argument.

- **No cabe duda de que**: the writer accepts a fact.
- **Sin embargo**: the turn. Here comes the problem.
- **Además**: one more point on the same side.
- **De ahí que**: the consequence.
- **En definitiva**: the conclusion.

Then look at each **subjunctive** and ask what triggered it: **se quejan de que**, **de ahí que**, **proponen que**, **por** pequeña **que**, **para que**.

Finally, guess unknown words from their parts: **masificado** comes from masa; **convivir** is con + vivir.
b2.f0.texto: Thousands of visitors arrive in the city every summer.
b2.f2.texto: However, the residents complain about the noise.
b2.f4.texto: That is why several organisers have decided to limit the tickets.
b2.f5.texto: Others propose that visitors pay a deposit.
b2.f6.texto: The challenge is to find a balance.
b2.f7.texto: That way visitors and residents will be able to live together.
b3.titulo: Words for a city in festival
b4.texto:
Each connector asks for a particular mood.

- **Quejarse de que** + subjunctive: los vecinos se quejan de que el centro **esté** masificado.
- **De ahí que** + subjunctive: **de ahí que** varios organizadores **hayan decidido** limitar las entradas.
- **Proponer que** + subjunctive: otros proponen que los visitantes **paguen** una fianza.
- **Por + adjective + que** + subjunctive: **por pequeña que sea**, it helps.
- **Para que** + subjunctive: un equilibrio **para que** puedan convivir.
- **No cabe duda de que** + indicative: los festivales **generan** ingresos.

The subjunctive appears when the action is a wish, a consequence or something being judged, not a plain fact.
b4.e0.texto: The residents complain that the centre is overcrowded.
b4.e1.texto: Hence several organisers have decided to limit the tickets.
b4.e2.texto: Visitors pay a deposit, however small it may be.
b5.f0.texto: As night falls, the old town fills with red and golden lights.
b5.f1.texto: The stages throb under spotlights that cross the sky like swords.
b5.f2.texto: The bass beats inside the chest of the whole crowd.
b5.f3.texto: A smell of fried food and cold beer rises from the full terraces.
b5.f4.texto: The shops open their doors and put tables out to the middle of the street.
b5.f5.texto: A resident watches the party from her balcony with her arms crossed.
b5.f6.texto: Her street, so quiet on other nights, now looks like a river of bodies.
b5.f7.texto: Even so, a small smile appears on her tired face.
b5.f8.texto: The music rises, falls and carries everyone towards dawn.
b5.f9.texto: In the end, the city and its visitors breathe the same warm air.
b6.o0.refuerzo: That is it: «generan ingresos y puestos de trabajo».
b6.o1.refuerzo: The text says the opposite: prices rise.
b6.o2.refuerzo: The text speaks of crowded shops, not protected ones.
b6.pregunta: What benefit do festivals have according to the text?
b7.frase: Los vecinos se quejan ____ que el centro esté masificado.
b7.pregunta: Complete with the preposition that «quejarse» takes.
b8.o0.refuerzo: That does not appear in the text.
b8.o2.refuerzo: The text does not speak of banning.
b9.frase: Pagan una fianza, por pequeña ____ sea.
b9.o0.refuerzo: «Porque» would give a cause, not a concession.
b9.o1.refuerzo: «Qué» has a tilde and is interrogative.
b9.o2.refuerzo: That is it: «por + adjective + que» + subjunctive.
b10.o0.refuerzo: It is not a wish: it is a consequence.
b10.o1.refuerzo: Being past is not enough for the subjunctive.
b10.o2.refuerzo: That is it: «de ahí que» always takes the subjunctive.
b10.pregunta: Why is «hayan decidido» in the subjunctive?
b11.frase: El reto es encontrar un equilibrio
b11.traduccion: The challenge is to find a balance
b12.pregunta: Write the noun that comes from «limitar».
p.festivales.consejo: Plural of «festival». The «v» sounds like «b», and the stress falls on «BA».
p.generan.consejo: From «generar», to produce. The «g» before «e» sounds like «h», so «he-NE-ran».
p.quejan.consejo: From «queja», a complaint. The «qu» before «e» is always «k». The «j» is pronounced «h».
p.organizadores.consejo: Plural of «organizador». The «z» sounds like «th» in Spain, and the stress falls on «DO».
p.decidido.consejo: From «decidir», to decide. The «-ido» ending is the past participle, used with «haber».
p.otros.consejo: Can be «otros» for a group of people, or the adjective «other» before a noun.
p.proponen.consejo: From «poner», to put, with «pro-» meaning forward. To propose is to put an idea forward.
p.paguen.consejo: From «pagar», to pay. The subjunctive is used after «que» to express a suggestion.
p.encontrar.consejo: From «contrar» with «en-» meaning in. The «c» before «o» is a «k», so «kon-TRAR».
p.podrán.consejo: From «poder», to be able. The «-rán» ending is the future for «ellos» or «ustedes».
p.escenarios.consejo: Plural of «escenario». The «io» is a diphthong, and the «c» before «e» sounds like «th».
p.vibran.consejo: From «vibrar», to vibrate. The «v» sounds like «b» in Spanish, so it is «BI-bran».
p.focos.consejo: Plural of «foco», the light or focus. The «c» before «o» is hard, like «k».
p.espadas.consejo: Plural of «espada», sword. The stress falls on «PA», and the «d» is soft.
p.multitud.consejo: A large group of people together. The stress falls on the last syllable, «TUD».
p.fritura.consejo: From «freír», to fry. The noun «fritura» names fried food, often served as tapas in Spain.
p.cerveza.consejo: In Spain the «c» before «e» sounds like «th», and the «v» like «b»: «ther-BE-tha».
p.terrazas.consejo: Plural of «terraza». The «rr» in the middle is strong, and the «z» is «th».
p.comercios.consejo: Plural of «comercio». The «c» before «o» is «k», and the «io» is a diphthong.
p.observa.consejo: From «observar», to watch closely. The «v» sounds like «b», so «ob-ser-BA».
p.cruzados.consejo: From «cruzar», to cross. Here it describes arms that are folded in front of the body.
p.noches.consejo: Plural of «noche». The «ch» is one sound, as in English «church».
p.cuerpos.consejo: Plural of «cuerpo». The «ue» forms a diphthong, read «we», and the «c» before «u» is «k».
p.respiran.consejo: From «respirar», to breathe. The «-an» ending is for «ellos» or «ellas».
p.crean.consejo: From «crear». The «e» and «a» are separate sounds, so it is «KRE-an».
p.empleo.consejo: Related to «emplear», to employ. The «e» and «o» are two open vowels, so they split into syllables.
p.pagan.consejo: From «pagar», to pay. The «g» before «a» is hard. The «-an» ending is for «ellos».
